# Feature: Magnet glove — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #63 (Magnet glove) from Gear and Items before it is used in real levels. Effect: pull metal blocks toward you. Unique: moves a block remotely, toward you, no push needed. Useful: retrieves blocks stranded across gaps or hazards. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** pull metal blocks toward you.

**So that** retrieves blocks stranded across gaps or hazards.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Magnet glove for the first time in its teaching room (mech-63-magnet-glove-room). Teaching moment: First room: a metal block stands across a gap with a wall in one pulling line and a clear line in the other. A player who pulls from the first position they reach either pulls nothing or pulls the block off its switch, which teaches that the glove works along a clear line and that the line is chosen by where you stand. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Held in a slot
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: When you press toward a metal block in a clear line within 3 tiles, the block slides one tile toward you and you stay
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Otherwise you move normally
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It cannot pull blocks through walls

## Edge Cases & Rules

- When you press toward a metal block in a clear line within 3 tiles, the block slides one tile toward you and you stay
- It cannot pull blocks through walls
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Magnet glove's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-63-magnet-glove-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/gear-and-items.yml mechanic #63.
